subject: Repeated surveys of line transects in R package Distance

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Repeated surveys of line transects in R package Distance
parts:
Dear list members,

How can I specify repeated visits or repeated surveys of line transects in the R package Distance.

Each of the transects was visited 6 times.

Manuel

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Repeated surveys of line transects in R package Distance
parts:
Manuel

Welcome to the list.

The simplest way is to combine detections from all six visits for each transect. Then assign effort for each transect to be six times the physical length of the transect.

If you have other questions, let us know.
